notes.title: Ver.1.0.0.2 Updated Contents
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue in which, in certain cases, the game could no longer be advanced after victory.
- Fixed an issue in which, in certain cases, Mitsuhide Akechi's preferred weapon would not be added.
- Fixed an issue with the actions of some characters.
- Fixed an issue with some scenarios.
- Carried out other bug fixes and balance adjustments.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.0.1 Updated Contents
notes.content: - Fixed an issue in which, when Full Screen Display was turned on, the game would only be displayed in full screen mode on a specific monitor.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
Thank you for purchasing SAMURAI WARRIORS 5.
Please find the answers to frequently asked questions below.
 
Q. Regarding System Requirements
  Please refer to the System Requirements listed on the store page.

Q. Regarding the Game Manual
  The game manual can be viewed via the following URLs. 
  English (US）	https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/manual/sw5/en/
  English (EU)	https://www.koeitecmoeurope.com/manual/sw5/en/

Other languages:
  Japanese	https://www.gamecity.ne.jp/manual/smusou5/jp/
  German (US)	https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/manual/sw5/de/
  German (EU)	https://www.koeitecmoeurope.com/manual/sw5/de/
  French (US)	https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/manual/sw5/fr/
  French (EU)	https://www.koeitecmoeurope.com/manual/sw5/fr/
  Traditional Chinese	https://www.gamecity.com.tw/manual/sengoku5/

Q. Regarding In-game Resolution Settings
  The resolution can be set in-game via the following steps.
  1. From the main menu select Settings.
  2. Select Resolution from the Graphics menu.
  There are no Graphics options within the Settings menu of the My Castle screen.
  You can only change these settings from the main menu.
  Please note that a 4K monitor is required to play the game in 4K.

Q. Regarding Changing the Language Settings
  The language settings can be changed via the following steps.
  1. Right click SAMURAI WARRIORS 5 within the Steam Client’s library tab and then select Properties.
  2. From the Properties window, select the Languages tab and then select the language you wish to use.

Q. Regarding Crashes Occurring After Updates
  1. Right click SAMURAI WARRIORS 5 from the Steam Client’s Library tab and select Properties.
  2. From the Properties window, select and run Verify integrity of game files from the Local Files tab.
